title: Mozart Exhibition Highlights
prompt: Describe the key features of the Mozart exhibition at New York's Morgan Library and Museum.
hint: Mention Mozart's early works, his family, and unique items on display.
sample: The exhibition showcases Mozart's earliest compositions, his sister Maria Ana, and his childhood violin, among other treasures.

title: Mozart's Personal Life and Letters

sample: Mozart's letters are known for their bathroom humor and flirtatious tone, showing his affectionate nature.

ja.sample: モーツァルトの手紙は下品なユーモアや軽妙な口調で知られており、彼の愛情深い性格がうかがえます。

title: Mozart's Family and Early Music Career

sample: Mozart's father managed tours across Europe and sold souvenirs, while his sister Maria Ana also composed music.

ja.sample: モーツァルトの父はヨーロッパ各地でのツアーを管理し、お土産を販売し、姉のマリア・アナも作曲をしていました。

title: Mozart's Legacy and Influence
prompt: Explain how Mozart's legacy was shaped after his early death and who helped enhance it.

sample: After Mozart died young at 35, composers like Chopin and Beethoven helped enhance his legacy, making him a lasting legend.
